해석: 링크만 있는 포스트이므로 영상의 구체적 주장, 종목, 숫자는 이 파일에서 새로 만들지 않았습니다. 향후 영상을 직접 확인한 뒤 섹터별 투자 포인트를 추가하는 방식이 맞습니다.

Biotech Second-Half Outlook Video Note

A short research note preserving analyst Eom Min-yong’s second-half biotech outlook video

Published: 2025-07-17 · Video-link archive · Naver Blog

Investment decisions are your responsibility. This material is research and is not a buy or sell recommendation.

0. Bottom line first

The source post contains only a link to analyst Eom Min-yong’s second-half biotech outlook video, without additional commentary. I therefore keep this as a concise research card focused on link preservation and follow-up review.

1. Material to review

Official fact: The video link in the source is https://youtu.be/lLkNqfReqv8?si=mKg2DUbNRoMhM0yI.

Interpretation: Because the post only contains a link, I did not invent any sector claims, stocks, or numbers. The right next step would be to review the video directly and then add sector-level takeaways.

Video link
